name.description: What people call it: one line of 1 to 100 characters, with no space at either end.

only.description: When the thing is there at all: the words that read after "only", one line of at most 100 characters. Left out when it is always there.

description.description: What it is responsible for, in 1 to 2,000 characters. Its first sentence says what the thing is: a box shows that sentence.

external.description: `true`: the people this model is kept for cannot change the system. Left out for a system of yours, and when nobody has said.

owner.description: The id of the owner, a record in owners/, who answers for the part. Left out, it is that of what the part is in.

description: Software its users see as one whole, ours or somebody else's. Nothing is above it. C4 calls it a software system.
